evals.name: booking-audit-only
evals.prompt: Run `npm install`, then mutation-audit the booking tests. I don't trust tests that have never failed. Audit only: do not change tests or production code. Write the audit notes to reports/mutation/audit-notes.json and tell me which tests are weak and why.
expectations: The agent runs the untouched baseline before mutating and records active and skipped counts.
It runs Stryker with the Vitest runner, disableBail and the JSON reporter, then reads the summarise-report triage view instead of the raw report.
It does not spawn one subagent per test or hand-craft mutations while the tool works.
The SAVE20 discount line is recorded as a gap with the missing contrasting example (SAVE20 on a standard booking).
'prices a premium booking' is flagged as having no unique kills and a weak assertion.
The claim check notices that non-integer nights are never tested, although no mutant survived there.
No test or production file changes; the notes validate as a complete audit-only campaign.

evals.name: booking-audit-and-rewrite
evals.prompt: Run `npm install`, then mutation-test the booking module and fix the weak tests you find. You may edit tests but not src/. Keep the audit notes in reports/mutation/audit-notes.json and show me the score before and after.
expectations: The agent triages before rewriting and records each survivor cluster's verdict and reason.
New or strengthened tests use exact values and a contrasting SAVE20-on-standard example rather than more assertions in an unrelated test.
It re-runs Stryker incrementally and uses summarise-report --compare to show the discount cluster now killed before marking it killed.
It adds a test for non-integer nights from the claim check, not only for Stryker survivors.
Production code is unchanged and the full suite passes.
The report states score before and after, verdicts, rewrites, and commands used.

evals.name: stryker-unavailable-fallback
evals.prompt: Mutation-audit test/payment.test.mjs, which uses node:test. The machine has no network access, so nothing can be installed. Audit only.
evals.expected_output: The agent follows the fallback order: it cannot install Stryker, so it uses manual mode in a throwaway copy with batched hand mutations, records engine manual in the notes, and never edits the user's checkout to restore mutations.
expectations: The agent does not claim a Stryker run happened.
Manual mutations happen in a disposable copy, not by reverse edits in the user's checkout.
Hand mutations are batched by module rather than one subagent per test.
The notes record engine manual and the final report states the reduced evidence.
